import org.agrona.concurrent.UnsafeBuffer;

import fix_sbe.*;

/**
 * Encodes, with Real Logic's codecs of Binance's Spot FIX SBE schema
 * (spot-fixsbe-1_1.xml), a message set with fixed values, and prints them
 * one per line, name then hexadecimal: the fixtures of binancefix's
 * generated codecs of the schema (internal/fixsbe) and of its client.
 * Every field is set, null ones to
 * the null value Real Logic's codecs give: they fill nothing on their own.
 *
 * With the argument "sofh", every message is printed framed: Binance's
 * Simple Open Framing Header, both its fields little-endian (the frame's
 * length, header included, then the encodingType 0xEB50), then the
 * message. Real Logic generates no codec of the schema's sofh composite,
 * which no message names: the header is written here.
 *
 * Every message's header is the one wrapAndApplyHeader writes (blockLength,
 * templateId, schemaId 1, version 1), then seqNum 4,000,000,000 + i and
 * sendingTime TS + 1,001 * i, i the message's index from 0.
 */
public class BinanceCheck {
    static final long TS = 1_719_479_845_223_000L; // 2024-06-27 09:17:25.223 UTC, in microseconds
    static final long ORDER_ID = 1_234_567_890_123L;
    static final String SIGNATURE = "4MHXelVVcpkdwuLbl6n73HQUXUf1dse2PCgT1DYqW9w8AVZ1RACFGM+5UdlGPrQHrgtS3CvsRURC1oj73j8gCA==";
    static final String API_KEY = "sBRXrJx2DsOraMXOaUovEhgVRcjOvCtQwnWj8VxkOh1xqboS02SPGfKi2h8spZJb";

    static final UnsafeBuffer buf = new UnsafeBuffer(new byte[1 << 16]);
    static final MessageHeaderEncoder h = new MessageHeaderEncoder();
    static boolean sofh;
    static int index;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        sofh = args.length > 0 && args[0].equals("sofh");

        // -- session --------------------------------------------------------

        LogonEncoder lo = new LogonEncoder();
        lo.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).encryptMethod((short) 0).heartBtInt(30).resetSeqNumFlag(BoolEnum.True)
            .messageHandling(MessageHandling.Sequential).responseMode(ResponseMode.OnlyAcks)
            .executionReportType(ExecutionReportType.Mini).dropCopyFlag(BoolEnum.False).recvWindow(5_000_000)
            .senderCompId("EXAMPLE").targetCompId("SPOT").rawData(SIGNATURE).username(API_KEY);
        print("Logon", lo.encodedLength());
        lo.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).encryptMethod(LogonEncoder.encryptMethodNullValue()).heartBtInt(5)
            .resetSeqNumFlag(BoolEnum.NULL_VAL).messageHandling(MessageHandling.NULL_VAL).responseMode(ResponseMode.NULL_VAL)
            .executionReportType(ExecutionReportType.NULL_VAL).dropCopyFlag(BoolEnum.NULL_VAL)

            .senderCompId("S").targetCompId("SPOT").rawData("").username("k");
        print("LogonNulls", lo.encodedLength());

        hb.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).testReqID("tr-1");

        // The longest a varString8 holds: its uint8 length's maxValue, 254
        // (255 is uint8's null), which Real Logic enforces.
        tr.wrapAndApplyHeader(buf, 0, h).testReqID(repeat("0123456789abcdef", 254));

            .sessionRejectReason(SessionRejectReason.NULL_VAL).errorCode(RejectEncoder.errorCodeNullValue()).refMsgType("").text("");
        print("RejectNulls", rj.encodedLength());

    static String repeat(String s, int length) {
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        while (b.length() < length) {
            b.append(s);
        }
        return b.substring(0, length);
    }

    /** Sets the header's seqNum and sendingTime, prints the message, and clears the buffer. */
    static void print(String name, int bodyLength) {
        h.wrap(buf, 0).seqNum(4_000_000_000L + index).sendingTime(TS + 1_001L * index);
        index++;
        int length = MessageHeaderEncoder.ENCODED_LENGTH + bodyLength;
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder(name).append(' ');
        if (sofh) {
            UnsafeBuffer frame = new UnsafeBuffer(new byte[6]);
            frame.putInt(0, 6 + length, java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
            frame.putShort(4, (short) 0xEB50, java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
                b.append(String.format("%02x", frame.getByte(i)));
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            b.append(String.format("%02x", buf.getByte(i)));
        }
        System.out.println(b);
        buf.setMemory(0, buf.capacity(), (byte) 0);
    }
}
